narrative.overview: Rudder is a dark operational surface: quiet in its foundations, explicit when a release is alive, building, or failing. Architecture is shown as precise service geometry, not decorative illustration.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Emerald is reserved for action, success, and the active release path.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only where the interface is naming code, a commit, a port, a command, or a measured state.

dos: Do show the system doing real work.
Do use charcoal tonal layers and 1px hairlines.
donts: Don't use invented benchmarks or cloud availability claims.
Don't turn the green accent into generic decoration.
Don't replace operational diagrams with icon-card grids.
